units.function: A 538-line real-Git and embedded-PostgreSQL integration suite for finalizing managed workspaces after an Agent switches away from the recorded branch.
units.dependencyDirection: Heartbeat realizes an isolated Git workspace, invokes an adapter, observes Agent-side Git and Issue/workspace mutations, runs finalization repair/adoption and persists WorkspaceOperation metadata plus Run/runtime state.
units.keyDataModels: ExecutionWorkspace recorded branch; actual Git branch/commits; Work/Issue status; worktree_prepare and workspace_finalize operations with validation/repair metadata.
units.lifecycle: If an unrecorded branch switch has no new commits, checkout the recorded branch before finalization; if it is a clean forward branch with commits, adopt that branch for the finalization operation without changing the durable workspace record; if the transition was already recorded, accept it directly; in all three cases persist operation evidence and allow the successful Run.
units.testAssessment: Three end-to-end cases use real Git and verify Run outcome, resulting branch/record and structured workspace operations. Missing are dirty/untracked/conflicted/diverged/detached HEAD, concurrent mutation, failed checkout/adoption, rollback after operation write failure, exact commit/tree evidence on the final Result, authorization for an Agent to update the workspace record, remote push/publication and restart between adapter exit and finalization.
units.designRationale: Preserve a coherent managed-workspace baseline while accepting legitimate forward work performed on a new publish branch and recording how finalization resolved the mismatch.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS must bind every code/data result to the exact finalized workspace snapshot even when a Connector changes branches or produces a derivative workspace during execution.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the post-execution validation and structured operation receipt. The ResultReceipt must name immutable commit/tree/content digests and the workspace lease epoch; branch labels are presentation only. A Connector may propose a transition but cannot update durable workspace identity directly: WorkspacePort validates and applies an authorized transition, with approval when risk policy requires it and an atomic audit outbox.
units.responsibilityConflict: Paperclip treats a successful adapter plus clean forward ancestry as sufficient for automatic finalization, without binding the branch transition to accountable-human authority or an approval/action digest. One test allows the Agent path to update ExecutionWorkspace directly, and another intentionally finalizes a branch not persisted as the workspace's durable branch, which can make later responsibility reconstruction ambiguous unless the exact commit is preserved elsewhere.
